exact_statement: Let h:{-1,1}^6->{-1,1} be negative exactly at binary input indices {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}, with bit0 denoting +1. For every nonconstant uniform-cube Boolean core g of every finite dimension n with minority output probability p_min in [1/16,1/2], orient g0 to P(g0=-1)=p_min, and set g1=g0 when p_min<=7/32 and g1=-g0 otherwise. Compose six disjoint identical copies F=h(g1,...,g1). For every relevant physical core coordinate i and every block j, B_(j,i)(F)/Inf_(j,i)(F)>=B_i(g)/Inf_i(g), where B_i=H(S_i|S_-i) for the squared uniform Fourier spectrum, in bits. The increase is strict when the singleton Fourier coefficient beta_i is nonzero. For the induced mean m and q=2p(1-p)^3(2-p), the exact signed reserve R_m(t)=sum_T phi(U_T,tD_T)-q phi(m^2,t) is nonnegative for all real t>=0 in the stated oriented bias bands, with equality at t=0. The full terminal identity is H(F)=6q H(g)+C_p with C_p=H_p(h)-6q h2(1-m^2), and I(F)=6q I(g). No arbitrary-dimensional rare-sector exclusion, iteration closure, or universal FEI bound is asserted.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean core on the uniform cube, finite arbitrary dimension and nonconstant
Minority probability in [1/16,1/2]; balanced tie may be oriented either way
Six identical core copies on disjoint physical variable blocks; specified six-bit gate
True conditional spectral erasure entropy and true physical influence; entropies in bits
Normalized orthonormal biased outer expansion used only as an exact composition identity

exact_statement: Let h be the six-bit Boolean sign negative exactly at binary indices {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}, a one bit denoting a negative input. For every nonconstant Boolean core g_0 on every finite uniform cube, define a finite-depth policy by orienting its minority output to -1, substituting six disjoint identical copies in that orientation when minority s<=7/32 and in its complement otherwise, and reorienting the output to its minority before the next level. For every finite depth d>=0, -2074/105<=H(g_d)/I(g_d)-H(g_0)/I(g_0)<=248/3, with true squared-spectrum entropy in bits and physical total influence. The moderate prefix alone has complete signed normalized entropy correction in [-314/21,200/3]. The exact identity H(g_(k+1))=Q_k H(g_k)+C_k, I(g_(k+1))=Q_k I(g_k), Q=12p(1-p)^3(2-p), C=H_p(h)-Q h2(4p(1-p)), retains the whole starting entropy, and every level correction C_k/(Q_k I(g_k)) is counted once. There is at most one low-moderate run and at most two complemented levels before the absorbing rare phase; no uniform number of low-moderate levels is required. These are additive composition bounds relative to the unknown starting ratio, not an absolute FEI constant or a physical restriction-tree payment, and do not price arbitrary alternating one-flip escape cycles.
